{"text":"ItemID: 1; Title: Fire TV Stick (3rd Gen) with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) + Star Wars The Mandalorian remote cover (Grogu Green); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a Fire TV Stick 4K Max, and the themed cover gives me little reason to buy another stick.
ItemID: 2; Title: Blink Whole Home Bundle | Video Doorbell System, Outdoor camera, and Mini camera | HD video, motion detection, Works with Alexa; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try expanding my basic door alarm setup with cameras that work with my existing Alexa devices.
ItemID: 3; Title: External DVD Drive USB 3.0 TYPE C Portable CD/DVD +/-RW Disk Drive DVD Player for Laptop CD/DVD ROM Burner Reader with Protective Carrying Case & 10 Blank Discs for Laptop Desktop Windows Linux Mac; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this for accessing older discs on my computers, much as I previously bought a floppy reader for older media.
ItemID: 4; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a fourth-generation Echo Dot, so this older model feels redundant.
ItemID: 5; Title: All-new Fire HD 10 tablet, 10.1", 1080p Full HD, 32 GB, latest model (2021 release), Black, without lockscreen ads; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not have a clear tablet need right now; my recent purchases focus more on home devices and computer accessories.
ItemID: 6; Title: Echo Show 8 (2nd Gen, 2021 release) - Glacier White - with 30-day FREE trial of Alexa Together (monthly auto-renewal); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The larger display interests me, but my recently purchased Show 5 and stand cover my current needs.
ItemID: 7; Title: Echo Dot (4th Gen) | Smart speaker with clock and Alexa | Twilight Blue; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: I like this model and color, but adding a clock is not enough to justify another purchase right now.
ItemID: 8; Title: SAMSUNG 870 QVO SATA III SSD 2TB 2.5" Internal Solid State Drive, Upgrade Desktop PC or Laptop Memory and Storage for IT Pros, Creators, Everyday Users, MZ-77Q2T0B; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Storage upgrades interest me, but I would first need to confirm that my computer supports this internal drive.
ItemID: 9; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a newer Show 5 and would prefer the newer Show 8 if I needed a larger screen.
ItemID: 10; Title: Apple AirPods Pro (1st Generation) with MagSafe Charging Case; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My history with Mac accessories does not give me an immediate need for earbuds, so I would pass this time."}
